title: Grateful Dead Live at West Palm Beach Auditorium on 1982-09-11
lineage: Cassettes > Sony TC-D5M > Audiophile 2496 Analog RCA Input > Soundforge > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC
source: Two AUD cassette sources of unknown lineage

ai_review.summary: High‑energy early‑80s show with a smoking Scarlet > Fire and strong Garcia work, captured in an unknown‑source recording of fair clarity.
ai_review.review: The performance is praised for Jerry Garcia’s fiery playing and vocals, especially on the Scarlet > Fire segue, Sailor, Terrapin Station and Stella Blue. Reviewers also note solid contributions from Brent (keys) and Dupree's as a set highlight, while the recording source is not identified and suffers from song‑labeling confusion, giving it only a fair technical rating.

ai_rating.rationale: Strong musical performance (high energy, many standout songs) balanced against unclear recording source and mislabeling issues; overall weighted rating falls in the good‑to‑average range.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No explicit mention of soundboard or audience source. Reviewers note song mislabeling and unclear crowd/tuning description, suggesting only average clarity.

poor_songs: Around n Around / OMSN doubleheader (described as fun but nothing special)
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for its energetic flow, with seamless transitions especially between Scarlet and Fire; the first set builds strong momentum leading into a high‑impact second set.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Garcia is described as 'on fire', delivering powerful guitar solos, passionate vocals, and driving the band throughout the show.
band_member_comments.Phil: Phil's bass is noted as not loud enough (possibly speaker issue), but no major criticisms of his playing.
band_member_comments.Bob: Bob Weir is said to work hard on lyric memorization but lacks emotional connection in his delivery.
band_member_comments.Keys: Brent (keyboards) receives praise for locking in with Jerry and adding valuable texture throughout the set.
